name: Juazeiro do Norte

queries.query: Juazeiro do Norte Brazil official cadastral parcel map municipal GIS property cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the municipal service catalogue, official municipal open-data portal, municipal geoprocessing service description, and official city-map/publication pages. The evidence establishes a local municipal cadastre/geoprocessing custodian, but no public anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Juazeiro do Norte cadastro imobiliário mapa cadastral parcelas geoprocessamento prefeitura serviço oficial
queries.result: A busca nativa/local located the official Prefeitura de Juazeiro do Norte service catalogue entries for Cadastro de Imóvel, Cadastro de Loteamento, and Alteração de Cadastro Imobiliário, plus the municipal geoprocessing service and official map publications. No anonymous parcel feature service or safe ID-plus-geometry response was found.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Juazeiro do Norte, especially Secretaria Municipal de Finanças for Cadastro Imobiliário and Secretaria Municipal de Infraestrutura for geoprocessing; official service pages describe cadastral registration and municipal geoprocessing.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Local municipal evidence is present: the official service catalogue describes Cadastro de Imóvel for urban/rural property, Cadastro de Loteamento for individualized lots, and Alteração de Cadastro Imobiliário. The Infrastructure geoprocessing page says georeferenced files may be made available to the community.
officialSourceAssessment.generalAgencyEvidence: IBGE official maps were found for municipal/census context only; they are not evidence of a Juazeiro do Norte parcel registry or parcel-vector API.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved the official municipal service catalogue, open-data portal, services page, and publication/map pages. The service page exposed an IPTU second-copy link and a general Google Maps embed, not a cadastral parcel viewer. The open-data portal exposed generic JSON/CSV export routes for listed datasets; no parcel/cadastre dataset or parcel geometry route was identified in the bounded HTML/configuration inspection. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
